summary: detect_provider_from_path(path) — maps a URL scheme (or bare path) to a CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE. Used by StorageFacade.from_path() and read_bytes() to select the correct backend based on path string alone.
extension_points: Mapping from scheme to provider type must be updated when adding new backends
documentation_hooks: Used implicitly by from_path() — users do not call this directly but its scheme→provider mapping determines path-driven dispatch
risks: Bare paths (no scheme) must be detected as LOCAL — any ambiguity here silently routes to wrong backend
